title: E-scooter Injuries Among Children Rise Sharply in UK
summary: A study from three major UK trauma centers revealed a significant increase in e-scooter related injuries among children. Between 2019 and 2024, 477 children were injured, with some as young as nine years old. The rise in injuries has been described as a 'public health challenge'.
summary_points: 477 children were injured by e-scooters in the UK between 2019 and 2024.
The study was conducted by three major trauma centers in the United Kingdom.
Some injured children were as young as nine years old.
The increase in e-scooter injuries among children is considered a 'public health challenge'.

चोटिल बच्चों में नौ साल जितने छोटे बच्चे भी शामिल थे।
